name: Mirrors
source:
Mirrors is a horror visual novel about a group of friends trying to contact a ghost. 

A presence has been following Avery ever since she was a kid. When her friend finds a way to free her from it, it may be her one shot at having a normal life. But the presence doesn't like to be interfered with, and Avery and her friends are in much more danger than they realize.

[From [url=https://azurekitsu.itch.io/mirrors]Itch.io[/url]]
